Name: LensLink
Description: Control the LensLink iPhone camera in OBS: start and stop, lenses, zoom, focus, exposure, white balance and more, with keys that show the camera's live state.

cam.lenslink.streamdeck.camera.Name: Camera
cam.lenslink.streamdeck.camera.Tooltip: Start or stop the camera on the phone.

cam.lenslink.streamdeck.pause.Name: Pause
cam.lenslink.streamdeck.pause.Tooltip: Hold the picture without ending the stream.

cam.lenslink.streamdeck.flip.Name: Flip camera
cam.lenslink.streamdeck.flip.Tooltip: Switch between the front and back camera.

cam.lenslink.streamdeck.lens.Name: Lens
cam.lenslink.streamdeck.lens.Tooltip: Jump to one lens, or cycle through them.

cam.lenslink.streamdeck.zoom.Name: Zoom
cam.lenslink.streamdeck.zoom.Tooltip: Key: go to a set zoom. Dial: turn to zoom, press for 1×.

cam.lenslink.streamdeck.flashlight.Name: Flashlight
cam.lenslink.streamdeck.flashlight.Tooltip: Turn the phone's flashlight on or off.

cam.lenslink.streamdeck.lock.Name: Lock
cam.lenslink.streamdeck.lock.Tooltip: Lock what auto is doing right now, or hand it back to auto.

cam.lenslink.streamdeck.white-balance.Name: White balance
cam.lenslink.streamdeck.white-balance.Tooltip: Key: lock at a temperature or go back to auto. Dial: turn for kelvin, press for auto.

cam.lenslink.streamdeck.calibrate.Name: Calibrate white balance
cam.lenslink.streamdeck.calibrate.Tooltip: Hold white paper or a gray card in the middle of the picture, then press.

cam.lenslink.streamdeck.exposure.Name: Exposure
cam.lenslink.streamdeck.exposure.Tooltip: Key: step EV up or down, or set it. Dial: turn for EV, press for 0.

cam.lenslink.streamdeck.iso.Name: ISO and shutter
cam.lenslink.streamdeck.iso.Tooltip: Dial: turn for ISO or shutter, press to switch between them, tap the screen for auto exposure.

cam.lenslink.streamdeck.focus.Name: Focus
cam.lenslink.streamdeck.focus.Tooltip: Key: auto focus, face focus or a saved position. Dial: turn to focus, press for auto.

cam.lenslink.streamdeck.green-screen.Name: Green screen
cam.lenslink.streamdeck.green-screen.Tooltip: Cut out the background on the phone.

cam.lenslink.streamdeck.format.Name: Format
cam.lenslink.streamdeck.format.Tooltip: Switch resolution, frame rate and codec in one press.

cam.lenslink.streamdeck.mic.Name: Microphone
cam.lenslink.streamdeck.mic.Tooltip: Pick which phone mic feeds the source.
